verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents a broad public API surface. It covers HTTP V2 event ingestion, event export, the Dashboard REST API for chart data as JSON, the Behavioral Cohorts API (list, export, upload), Taxonomy CRUD for event types and properties, and Experiment APIs for managing flags and experiments from CI or scripts. A probe also confirmed a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at amplitude.com/openapi.json. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these APIs work well when driven programmatically.
